text:
A zebra stands in stripes of black and white,
While gardens breathe in quiet, hushed delight.
The flowers bloom with promises untold,
Their petals soft, their hidden splendor bold.

The trees stand guard, like sentinels of old,
Their rustling leaves in ancient wisdom rolled.
Here, in this green and sacred, silent space,
We find our peace in life’s enduring grace.

For every bloom, each leaf that falls away,
Reveals the story of the passing day.
In growth and decay, the cycle turns,
As nature’s quiet lesson gently burns.
